facts.text: The research found no documented case in any sector where a collision-avoidance or automatic-braking function was fully validated in about four months for a new machine family.
facts.quote: The research found no documented case, in any sector, where a collision-avoidance or automatic-braking function was fully validated in about four months for a new machine family.

facts.text: Documented cases in which physical testing really shrank shared years of prior investment in simulation and statistical tooling, a deliberately narrow operating envelope, or both.
facts.quote: The cases where physical testing really did shrink had three things in common: years of prior investment in simulation and statistical tooling

facts.text: Aviation's ACAS X, Germany's PEGASUS and VVM projects, and Sweden's EVIDENT are examples of cases where reduced physical testing was supported by years of prior investment in simulation and statistical tooling.
facts.quote: years of prior investment in simulation and statistical tooling (aviation's ACAS X, the German PEGASUS and VVM projects, Sweden's EVIDENT)

facts.text: Volvo CE's wheel-loader system is an example of reduced physical testing with a deliberately narrow operating envelope: reverse-only operation at 3 to 15 km/h.
facts.quote: a deliberately narrow operating envelope (Volvo CE's reverse-only, 3 to 15 km/h wheel-loader system)
